system.description:
You were raised where the sea shapes all things. Whether in bustling port towns or aboard ships that never dock, your people live by the tides. From a young age, you learned to sail, fish, and survive rough waters. Your people are prized as sailors and navigators, carrying the rhythms of the ocean in their blood.

Know the Tide. You can sense the ebb and flow of life. When you roll with Fear, make a note of it. You can hold a record equal to your level. Before you make an action roll, you can spend any number of these failures to gain a +1 bonus to the roll for each failure spent. At the end of each session, clear the record.
